name: Sensor terminal block
summary: A sensor terminal organises supply, return and signal connections for a documented sensor wiring arrangement.
description: A sensor terminal organises supply, return and signal connections for a documented sensor wiring arrangement. Multilevel construction may separate the signal path from bridged supply potentials.
readingNotes: Follow each level to the sensor's supply and output terminals.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A sensor terminal's physical levels do not imply that all conductors are electrically common.
